egress.scope: Linux TCP/HTTPS egress boundary through a dedicated bridge gateway and isolated protocol fixtures; separate from product SSH/K3s/registry execution.

httpBoundaryFix.baselineFailure:
Expected values to be strictly equal:

502 !== 413
httpBoundaryFix.cause: Fastify forced Connection: close for an oversized request before Caddy finished forwarding the body. API logged 413 while the proxy saw an upstream TCP reset and returned 502.
httpBoundaryFix.fix: Only FST_ERR_CTP_BODY_TOO_LARGE removes the forced close header and drains without buffering. An absolute drain deadline uses the existing server requestTimeout (15000 ms in production); end/close releases the timer.

checks.name: delivers 413 before upload completion, drains it, and reuses the TCP connection
closes an incomplete rejected upload at the request deadline

covers: complete rejected upload drains and the same TCP connection survives beyond the deadline for a subsequent GET
incomplete rejected upload closes within the configured deadline

httpBoundaryFix.peerReview: A separate read-only review found no blocking drain/keepalive issue; repeated chunked framing is also covered by the final Compose smoke.

cacheProvenance.transport: Read-only Docker image save from Mac to C; no Mac tags were changed. Official Docker Hub pull from C failed, so verified imported caches were used.

artifact.transport: Docker save streamed through verified SSH to Mac filesystem; no second C archive and no Mac Docker load

retainedEarlierFailures.cause: bridge and bip options conflicted; only the dedicated daemon configuration was corrected
C Docker Hub connection refusal and Debian HTTP timeout; immutable imported image bindings and signed HTTPS package downloads used
Oversized request returned proxy 502 instead of API 413; corrected with the separately hashed four-file patch

retainedEarlierFailures.phase: HTTP fix build before capacity increase
retainedEarlierFailures.cause: Explicit free-space guard stopped before migrate; C alone expanded to 28 GiB, preserving all data
umask narrowed source directories to 0700; runtime UID could not traverse them. Directory modes restored to 0755; all 279 file bytes, file modes and archive SHA unchanged

limits: Linux ARM64 on local C, not an AMD64 or public VPS acceptance
Egress fixtures verify real TCP/TLS/protocol connectivity, not remote product credentials or private registry lifecycle; those have separate S3 records
Local CA HTTPS does not establish public DNS/ACME trust
Resource samples and command durations are observations, not production capacity or RPO/RTO commitments
